purpose: Durable advisory company and actor preferences for decision interpretation and scoring.
invariants: Preferences are advisory and never an authority source.
company_id is the sole company boundary.
Actor preferences are always company-scoped and cannot leak across companies.
Preference keys that attempt to mutate identity, company boundary, roles, permissions, entitlement, policy, approval, autonomy or execution authority are rejected.
Expired preferences are retained historically but excluded from effective projections.
Explicit preferences outrank inferred preferences at equal scope and key.
Actor preferences may specialize company defaults only for allowed advisory keys.
